title: PES 0110 writes a decorative fill with its pattern in the object's pattern block
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a decorative fill region as region type 13 and its pattern into the object's pattern block, as PE-DESIGN 11.50 does for the owner's one-line pattern (compat/reference/stitches/deco-fill-1line-100mm.pes; pattern crates/openstitch-design/tests/fixtures/patterns/psc-deco-1line.plf, `@TILELINE 0 2 128 128 896 896`): u16 size in 0.01 mm (10000 for 100 mm), then the lines in a 1024-unit cell. The design is that spec's (deco-fill-1line-100mm): the 40 mm square at (30,30) mm filled with the pattern at 100 x 100 mm.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 pattern block: deco-fill-1line-100mm's block is its .plf (pes11.rs, region_types_and_the_decorative_pattern_read); its rewrite is byte-identical outside the documented differences

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-decorative-fill` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-decorative-fill/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: a 40 mm square at (30,30) mm with region Decorative Fill Stitch using the one-line pattern (a single diagonal, as psc-deco-1line), 100 x 100 mm, as compat/reference/stitches/deco-fill-1line-100mm.pes. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, which pattern the region shows (the one line, or another), its size, and the status-bar size and stitch count against that file's. Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.
